observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 100.» (L25) in the left margin. The count of the lines runs through the space before the head of chapter 32 and through the head: 30 stands beside the empty line under L29, 35 beside the second line of the title. By that count the last line of the page (L36) is line 40; no number is printed beside it.
body L30-L32: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type and centred; the title is in two lines.
body L8: the letter of the reference (d) is bold italic.
body L12: the 4 of «4° 1/2» is printed faint, its left part hardly visible.

body L33-L35: the names of the Arab months are transliterated as printed: ǵ with an acute, à with a grave for the final alif of «ǵumādà» (both measured on the scan), the turned comma ‘ for the ‘ayn; L35 begins with the apostrophe of «’l-qa‘dah», printed like a raised point. «al–muḥarram» (L33) and the second «’l–ḥiǵǵah» (L35) have the longer dash, the first «’l-ḥiǵǵah» and «’l-qa‘dah» a hyphen.
body L36: the note figure is printed «(6)», where note 7 is meant; kept as printed.
body L24: a point stands low before «fere»; it is not a sign.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
